title: Investigation of the Safety and Efficacy of Renzapride in Constipation Predominant Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to investigate whether renzapride will help alleviate the symptoms associated with constipation predominant irritable bowel syndrome in female patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Females with constipation predominant IBS as defined by the Rome II criteria
* Colonoscopy or sigmoidoscopy in previous 5 years showed no significant disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have diarrhoea predominant or alternating symptom IBS
* Other gastrointestinal diseases that affect bowel transit
